verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop is a general-purpose OS where background automation (e.g., cron/systemd timers, agent scheduling) is plausible, but the evidence pack contains no mention of automation frameworks, task scheduling, or AI-agent orchestration capabilities—only a generic 'start an application at login' doc entry, which is not autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: any documentation of scheduling/automation tooling (cron, systemd timers, or AI-agent orchestration), evidence of autonomous background task execution, and any AI-native automation setup guidance.
